meta.name: succession-power-transfer
meta.description: Use when managing a leadership succession or transferring power between rulers. Covers designation, mourning period (三年丧), abdication gesture, popular validation by regional leaders (诸侯), and formal assumption of authority.

copy.tagline: 模拟古代王位传承与权力交接流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚构或教育场景中模拟古代君主制权力过渡。
copy.tagline_en: Simulate ancient royal succession and power transfer processes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to model ancient monarchical power transitions in fictional or educational contexts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能够按照古代中国继承礼制，协助管理统治者之间的权力交接流程，包括指定继承人、安排丧期、执行禅让仪式、获取诸侯认可并完成正式即位。
howto.when: 当用户需要安排领导人更替或权力转移，涉及指定继承人、丧期、禅让、诸侯支持等环节时触发。

say.text: 请按古代礼制安排王位继承。
say.note: Claude会启动完整的权力交接流程。

say.text: 我需要设计一个权力交接流程，包含三年丧期和诸侯认可。
请模拟禅让仪式，让继承人先推辞再接受。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can manage a leadership succession process based on ancient Chinese rituals, including designating a successor, observing a mourning period, performing abdication gestures, obtaining regional leaders' validation, and formal assumption of authority.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to arrange a leadership transition or power transfer involving designation, mourning, abdication, regional support, and formal ascension.

say_en.text: Arrange the succession according to ancient rituals.
say_en.note: Claude will start the full succession process.

say_en.text: Design a power transfer process with a three-year mourning period and regional validation.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the steps in order.

say_en.text: Simulate the abdication ritual, having the heir first decline then accept.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate the abdication step.
